artworks.title: Achilles Lamenting the Death of Patroclus
artworks.description: Ge paints the grief at the heart of Homer's Iliad — Achilles mourning Patroclus, the wrath that nearly lost the war and the friendship the whole Trojan decade turns upon.

artworks.title: The Procession of the Trojan Horse
artworks.description: Tiepolo's Trojans drag Odysseus' stratagem through the Scaean Gate — the Sack of Troy episode that closes the war the Iliad never reaches.
